highlight.note: The key: an arrow out for what an app sends a service, an arrow in for what it receives.
A column for each platform service an app has used, named by what it does, with how many apps use it.
A row for each app. Each cell says which way data travels and what it is: prompts, signed-in people, stored records.
Point at a cell, or reach it with the arrow keys, to light its row and column; its tooltip says it as a sentence.
